This page is a list of all available '''potions''' in {{TWMS}}. ==PRE-1.2.0== Potions could be crafted using combination of [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|monster remains]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|herbs]] gathered from shrubs. [[The Witcher Monster Slayer bestiary|Monsters]] of any level dropped both [[powdered monster tissue]] and [[The Witcher Monster Slayer ingredients|monster remains]]. Aside from crafting, which required time, it was possible to buy all potions at [[Thorstein]]'s shop.
